sahneler.metin: On approach to Dallas, a Lockheed TriStar slammed into the ground.
It hit cars and a water tank, and more than one hundred thirty people were killed.
It had flown beneath a thunderstorm.
A microburst was blasting down from the cloud.
First a headwind, then a downdraft, then a sudden tailwind.
The jet lost airspeed too close to the ground to recover.
Airports and jets now carry wind-shear detection.

aciklama:
Delta 191 crashed short of the runway at Dallas/Fort Worth. The cause: microburst wind shear causing a sudden loss of airspeed and lift near the ground.

#shorts #engineering #aviation

vaka.tartisma: Detection technology followed the crash. How many hazards do we understand only after a disaster?
